recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-16464.
issue_request: FHIR-16464 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request for CodeSystem.identifier. It asked to align the short description with ValueSet.identifier by adding the business identifier parenthetical; the resolution noted the proposed text had a typo and should say CodeSystem rather than ValueSet.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14682, represented in git as 4b4fccef7fa6b5efd4ce2d03c03062f5c4e866d9 (GF#16464 - fix definition), which added the business identifier parenthetical to the legacy CodeSystem spreadsheet source. Later source refactoring replaced the spreadsheet with structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml and retained the requested wording.
additional_context: CodeSystem is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The combined branch source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml has CodeSystem.identifier short = "Additional identifier for the code system (business identifier)". A directly relevant Zulip clarification thread confirms that the block vote noticed the issue text's ValueSet typo. FHIR-16722 also touched CodeSystem.identifier, but only for cardinality/comment guidance and does not change this short-description reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already carries the approved CodeSystem-specific business identifier wording in the active StructureDefinition source, so adding or changing prose would be redundant and risk drift.
